findings.location: Registration 3.2 c) Manager "run Round 2"; SRS FR-APP-07
findings.finding: Round 2 run by a Manager has no implementation. Offers are created only automatically when a Block of the assignment is committed. There is no Manager endpoint or screen. Beds freed later (unpaid Balance, unpaid next-Term fee, ended stay, termination) are never offered, although FR-APP-07 says they are. The trigger milestone "M8" is defined nowhere.
findings.evidence: AssignmentService.java:345 is the only caller of Round2Offers.offer; Round2Controller has only GET /students/me/round2-offer and POST /round2-offers/{id}/respond; web router has only /student/round-2-offer; ForfeitService.java:28 "Round 2 may offer it"; "M8" appears only in r3-fr.md:295
findings.response: Fixed – 28/10/2026: Manager › Assignment › Round 2 offers every free Bed (left by Round 1, or freed by forfeits, unpaid next-Term fees, ended stays and terminations) to the waitlisted students without an open offer, by the rules of the automatic offers (TC-APP-024); M8 is when the Manager runs it, after M7 and the Balance deadline (gap G7 closed)

top5.summary: Round 2 run by a Manager (FR-APP-07) is not implemented: offers are made only when a Block is committed, and Beds freed later are never offered.
None of the five main workflows WF-01…WF-05 has an executed end-to-end test (5 manual cases, all Not run).
NFR-01, NFR-03, NFR-04 and NFR-06 cannot be shown met: the load script, timed run and concurrency test do not exist and 4 of 6 NFR cases are Not run.
A Manager can mark an Unpaid or Overdue Invoice Paid with no student claim; this path is missing from the Invoice and claim state machines and from FR-BIL-03.
The Term state Closed has no triggering FR and is never set by code, so published Terms never close.
